Volume - 161 BENGALURU, THURSDAY, 19, FEBRUARY, 2026(MAGHA, 30, SHAKAVARSHA, 1947) Issue 34

KARNATAKA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
(DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATIONS)
UDYOGA SOUDHA : BANGALORE - 1.
No.:PSC 505 DE/2025-2026/626 Dated:07-02-2026

The results of the Departmental Examinations II-Session 2024 ( Excluding
IAS/IFS/IPS candidates only )held by the Commission during May-2025 is as follows:
1)The Subject-wise Provisional List of Register Numbers of the candidates who
have passed is given in APPENDIX-A.
2)The Subject-wise list of Register Numbers who have passed only in certain
papers by obtaining exemption and who have obtained the exemption being a Law or
Commerce graduate is given in APPENDIX-B.
3)The Subject-wise list of Register Numbers of the candidates exempted from
appearing for a particular paper or papers, subject to passing the examination as a
whole within the next two years is given in APPENDIX-C.
4)List of With-held and Cancelled/Rejected register numbers of the
candidates is given in APPENDIX-D.
Note : Retotalling option is available only for descriptive papers. Candidates
who wish to apply may do so by paying Rs.100/paper through Online within 30 days of
publication of this notification

The results of the Departmental Examinations II-Session 2024 ( Excluding IAS/IFS/IPS
candidates only )held by the Commission during May-2025 is as follows:

passed is given in APPENDIX-A.

obtaining exemption and who have obtained the exemption being a Law or Commerce graduate is given
in APPENDIX-B.

a particular paper or papers, subject to passing the examination as a whole within the next two
years is given in APPENDIX-C.
4)List of With-held and Cancelled/Rejected register numbers of the candidates is
given in APPENDIX-D.

Note : Retotalling option is available only for descriptive papers. Candidates who wish
to apply may do so by paying Rs.100/paper through Online within 30 days of publication of this
notification
